1.mascotDialogue: Build the heap once, then just keep pulling the max off the top! Each pull's one more element locked into its correct, final spot.

2.mascotDialogue: Two loops — build the heap once, lines 2 and 3. Then swap-and-shrink, again and again, lines 5 through 7. That 'end' boundary shrinking each time, that's what carves the sorted region out the back.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar walk to the top, then swap all the way to the right — one value, locked into its sorted home!

4.mascotDialogue: This step's easy to forget, güey — the array still looks like it's changing every loop! It just never converges into sorted order without it, no matter how busy it looks.
